author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Creating forms used to take time—dragging fields, setting up logic, and tweaking layouts. But what if you could just describe your form… and it builds itself? In this video, I’ll show you how Jotform’s new AI Form Builder lets you create fully functional forms in seconds—just by typing (or even speaking). You’ll see how to:
- Instantly generate a complete form from a simple prompt 
- Edit fields and design using AI (no menus required) 
- Add advanced logic without manual setup 
- Publish and share your form in seconds 
- Analyze responses using built-in AI insights 

Whether you're creating event registrations, feedback forms, or customer surveys, this completely changes how forms get built.
